meta.title: Rental income estimator for Mauritius
meta.description: What could your villa, apartment or penthouse in Mauritius earn as a holiday rental? Five quick questions, an indicative monthly and yearly range — free.

header.title: What could your property earn?
header.intro: Five quick questions, about 30 seconds. You’ll see an indicative monthly and yearly range for your property — in euros or rupees — and what stays with you after our fee.

type.title: What kind of property is it?

region.title: Where on the island is it?
region.hint: Rental rates vary from one coast to another.

bedrooms.title: How many bedrooms does it have?
bedrooms.hint: Count the bedrooms your guests can sleep in.

features.title: What sets it apart?
features.hint: Select all that apply — or none at all.

availability.title: When can guests stay?
availability.hint: Let it all year, or keep some weeks for yourself.

villa.name: Villa
villa.description: A house of its own, often with a garden

apartment.name: Apartment
apartment.description: A flat in a residence or building

penthouse.name: Penthouse
penthouse.description: A top-floor apartment, usually with a terrace

west.name: West
west.towns: Flic en Flac, Tamarin, Black River

centre.name: Centre / Other
centre.towns: Moka, Curepipe and the rest of the island
centre.located: in the centre or elsewhere on the island

features.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected — that’s fine too.} one {# selected} other {# selected}}

yearRound.title: Rent it year-round
yearRound.description: Open to guests all {weeks} weeks of the year

partYear.title: I use it part of the year
partYear.description: Choose how many weeks guests can book

availability.weeksPerYear: {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}} a year

result.title: What your property could earn
result.disclaimer: Indicative estimate based on regional averages — your free assessment gives the exact figure.
result.occupancy: {yearRound, select, yes {Based on about {occupancy, number, percent} occupancy across the year} other {Based on about {occupancy, number, percent} occupancy over the {weeks, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}} you make available}} — {high, number, percent} in high season ({highFrom, date, ::MMM}–{highTo, date, ::MMM}), {low, number, percent} in low season ({lowFrom, date, ::MMM}–{lowTo, date, ::MMM}).

breakdown.title: Where it goes
breakdown.note: Your fee is agreed with you after our first meeting and never exceeds {maxFee, number, percent} of gross rental income. No hidden fees — every cost is itemised on your monthly statement.

rental.title: Your rental, run end to end
rental.copy: Listing, marketing and pricing, enquiries, bookings and guest check-ins — we handle all of it.

care.title: Guest-ready all year
care.copy: Preventive care, repairs and regular inspections keep your property in good order year-round.

reporting.title: Every figure in view
reporting.copy: One contact who knows your property, clear monthly statements, and occupancy and revenue live on your owner dashboard.

cta.primary: Get your exact figure — free assessment

method.title: Clear assumptions, nothing hidden
method.sub: We show a range — {spread, number, percent} either side of our central figure — because no two properties are alike. Your free assessment replaces it with the real number.

rates.title: Regional nightly rates
rates.copy: We start from typical nightly rates for your type of property and region, then adjust for bedrooms and for features such as a private pool or a sea view.

occupancy.title: Seasonal occupancy
occupancy.copy: We assume about {high, number, percent} occupancy in high season ({highFrom, date, ::MMMM} to {highTo, date, ::MMMM}) and {low, number, percent} in low season, spread over the weeks you make available.

fees.title: Our fee, up front
fees.copy: Your management fee is agreed with you and never exceeds {maxFee, number, percent} of gross rental income — so the estimate shows what stays with you.

teaser.title: What could your property earn?
teaser.pitch: Five quick questions, about 30 seconds: an indicative monthly and yearly range for your villa, apartment or penthouse.
